t: This is Conduit Street, a street in Mayfair that connects Bond Street to Regent Street. Two people are linked to it. Henry Colburn, a British publisher, lived here. And Lieutenant-General Frederick Markham, a British Army officer who served as Adjutant-General in India, died here. So as you walk it between two of the West End's great streets, you are passing the homes of a publisher and a soldier.
